quarterly_data.signal: Caterpillar's 10-Q states firm backlog was approximately $72.1 billion at the end of the second quarter of 2026, with increases across the three primary segments and the largest in Power & Energy. Of the total backlog at June 30, 2026, approximately $29.2 billion was not expected to be filled in the following twelve months.
quarterly_data.figure: ~$29.2 billion of the June 30, 2026 backlog not expected to be filled in the following twelve months

quarterly_data.signal: The 10-Q capital expenditure reconciliation lists Power & Energy segment capital expenditures of $328 in the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus $374 a year earlier, and $619 in the six months ended June 30, 2026 versus $614 (millions of dollars). The 10-Q says Caterpillar is progressing on its capacity expansion plans and expects to increase throughput in the second half of 2026.
